Hi Marcus / Emma,

Thanks for the quick responses — were excited to see Redwood in action. Quick heads-up: our India team will be mostly OOO for Diwali from 2026-10-31 through 2026-11-03, and our Japan office has planned time off around Golden Week style observances the first week of May (we know this is a while out, but we have cross-region stakeholders with limited windows).

Because our execs in London and Mumbai need to attend live, were hoping to find an "overlap bridge" window that doesnt force anyone to tune in at 2am local time. Do you have any recommended compact time windows that reliably hit late-morning London / early-evening India / early-morning Pacific? We can be flexible within those constraints.

Also attaching a rough availability grid for our side.

High-level asks for the demo:
- 30–40 minute demo of Redwood hosted inference + a 10 minute Q&A
- Short notes on expected latency numbers for doc summarization workload (we'll share sample prompts separately)
- A clear fallback plan if the primary model is swapped during the demo

Appreciate any bridge proposals you can share — Emma and I will coordinate internal approvals once you provide options.

Best,
Sanjay
Head of Platform Integrations
NimblePay
